comparison.objective: Open six binder rings, thread a divider onto all rings, release it, and close the rings; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Notebook stabilization, lever actuation, multi-hole alignment and threading, and ring closure versus mandrel-to-insert coaxial alignment, bimanual hammering, snag-free withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Rings opened, divider released on all six half-rings, then rings closed versus four tangs fractured and collected with each insert retained and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Despite demanding alignment and latching, six-hole assembly tests distributed insertion and closure rather than impact fracture and debris containment.
